description: This file is a Python script that manages the execution flow of a repository analysis tool called 'ladybug'. It handles command-line arguments, repository collection, parallel execution of analysis loops, and output formatting.

methods.name: print_banner
methods.description: Displays an ASCII art banner with colored text.

methods.name: run_loop
methods.description: Executes a single analysis loop, either with or without improvements, and outputs metrics.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that parses arguments, collects repositories, and manages execution flow including parallel processing.
